skill.name: offsite-signal-analyzer
skill.description: Analyzes off-site SEO signals for a domain. It profiles backlink quality, anchor mix, toxic-link candidates, link-building opportunities, and AI-assistant referral traffic from GA4, Search Console, or logs.
skill.summary: Analyze backlink quality and AI-assistant referral traffic for a domain.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code formatting, relative documentation links, metadata URLs, and SEO reference examples. I confirmed the three lines that explicitly tell the agent to run local Python connector or ledger commands; I found no prompt injection or malicious exfiltration intent.

remediation.issue: Local connector commands in skill instructions
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running connector or ledger commands, and pass user input as arguments without shell interpolation.

remediation.issue: Generated memory filenames use a free-form topic
remediation.suggestion: Sanitize the topic before saving under memory/monitoring. Remove slashes, traversal tokens, and control characters from filenames.

remediation.issue: Optional external benchmark references are broad
remediation.suggestion: State that public benchmark links may be fetched only when useful and must not include user analytics or log data.

content.value_statement: Off-site SEO and AI referral data can be hard to compare across tools. This skill turns exports and logs into backlink, toxicity, and AI-channel reports.
actual_capabilities: Classifies requests into backlink analysis or AI-referral analysis mode.
Profiles referring domains, anchor text, link quality, toxicity, and competitive gaps.
Builds disavow review guidance with safeguards against unnecessary removal.
Analyzes AI-assistant referral sessions from GA4, Search Console, or server logs.
Compares AI traffic against organic traffic for the same reporting window.
Creates monitoring handoff summaries for future comparison when the user approves saving.
limitations: It cannot measure backlinks or AI sessions without exports, logs, or connected tools.
It does not analyze internal links, keyword rankings, or full stakeholder reports.
AI referral traffic suggests a surfaced link, but it cannot prove citation prominence.
Connector command examples require local scripts and should be run only with approval.

use_cases.title: Audit a Backlink Profile
use_cases.description: Review referring domains, anchor mix, toxic-link share, and disavow candidates for a target domain.

use_cases.title: Measure AI Referral Traffic
use_cases.description: Use GA4, Search Console, or log exports to isolate visits from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and similar sources.

use_cases.title: Plan Link Building Priorities
use_cases.description: Compare competitors, find link gaps, and turn outreach opportunities into practical next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze My Backlinks
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner backlink audit with pasted export data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the backlink profile for [domain]. I will provide a referring-domain export with authority, anchor, target URL, and follow status.

prompt_templates.title: Review Toxic Link Risk
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate cleanup review before disavow decisions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these backlink rows for toxic-link risk. Separate weak links from true disavow candidates and explain the evidence for each recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Track AI Referral Sessions
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate AI traffic monitoring from analytics exports.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze AI-assistant referral traffic for [domain] over [date range]. Use my GA4 source-medium export and compare AI sessions with organic sessions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Off-Site Signal Changes
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced trend and attribution review across periods.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare backlink changes and AI referral movement between [period A] and [period B]. Label every metric source and separate observed change from likely cause.

output_examples.input: Analyze backlink profile for example.com using this referring-domain export.
output_examples.output: A backlink report with profile overview, anchor distribution, toxic-link review, competitor gap notes, and prioritized link actions.

output_examples.input: Track ChatGPT and Perplexity referral sessions for the last 90 days.
output_examples.output: An AI-referral report with matched sources, trend, top landing pages, AI-vs-organic comparison, and low-sample warnings.

output_examples.input: Find safe link-building opportunities from these three competitors.
output_examples.output: A prioritized opportunity list with overlapping referring domains, outreach angle, effort estimate, expected impact, and evidence notes.

best_practices: Provide source exports with dates, column definitions, and the reporting window.
Keep backlink metrics and AI referral metrics in separate sections.
Label each number as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
anti_patterns: Do not estimate referring-domain volume from a domain name alone.
Do not treat every low-authority link as toxic or worth disavowing.
Do not claim AI referral traffic proves a prominent AI citation.

faq.question: What data should I provide for backlink analysis?
faq.answer: Provide a backlink or referring-domain export with source domain, target URL, anchor text, follow status, authority, and date fields.

faq.question: Can it work without a paid SEO tool?
faq.answer: Yes, if you provide exported backlink data. Without data or a connected tool, it cannot measure link counts.

faq.question: Which AI traffic sources can it identify?
faq.answer: It starts with sources such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Claude, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Poe.

faq.question: Does it create a Google disavow file automatically?
faq.answer: No. It prepares review guidance and recommends disavow only when evidence supports it.

faq.question: Can it prove that an AI answer cited my page?
faq.answer: No. Referral traffic proves a visit from an AI surface, but not the exact citation position or answer context.

faq.question: Does it save results between sessions?
faq.answer: It can prepare a monitoring handoff and asks before saving results under memory/monitoring.
